text_to_image_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original landscape scene asset, 1536x1024, full-bleed independent image for an interactive story environment library. Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. Vintage mid-century travel-poster illustration of a lonely steam train station among vast desert dunes, copper canopy and small empty parked locomotive, bold simplified geometry, screenprinted paper texture, ochre-red dunes and navy shadows with pale golden sky, no typography, no title, purely full-bleed narrative environment.
